Effect: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 6 or lower Digimon. If you have 10 or more cards in your trash, instead delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By returning 10 non-Digi-Egg cards from your trash to the top of the deck, trash your opponent's top security card.
Special Rule: ＜Overflow (-5)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 5 memory.)
